name: Craftsman's Codex: Ranger Skinning does not take a primary profession slot after a relog
contract: Rangers (class 21) start with Skinning (8613), which Player::_addSpell and Player::removeSpell exempt from the primary profession count. The Craftsman's Codex recomputes free profession slots at every login and counted Ranger Skinning, so after a relog a Ranger with Skinning and one profession had no free slot left. Expected: after learning Alchemy (2259) and relogging, Apprentice Engineer (4039) is still available (0) in the Book of Artisans; after learning Tailoring (3908) as the second profession it is not a row (-1).

steps.label: Control: the Ranger starts with Skinning
Control: Skinning and Alchemy are still known after the relog
